subject: math
cluster: Measure and estimate lengths in standard units

items.prompt:
A crayon from $0$ to $8$ cm is
A) $8$ cm
B) $6$ cm
C) $0$ cm
D) $10$ cm

Where should measuring start on a ruler?
A) At $0$
B) At $1$
C) Anywhere
D) At the end

From $0$ to $12$ cm is
A) $11$ cm
B) $12$ cm
C) $13$ cm
D) $1$ cm

A stick from $2$ cm to $10$ cm is
A) $8$ cm
B) $12$ cm
C) $10$ cm
D) $2$ cm

A cm ruler measures length in
A) centimeters
B) pounds
C) minutes
D) dollars

From $0$ to $6$ inches is
A) $6$ inches
B) $5$ inches
C) $7$ inches
D) $0$ inches

A stick from $4$ cm to $12$ cm is
A) $8$ cm
B) $16$ cm
C) $12$ cm
D) $4$ cm

Why start at $0$ when measuring?
A) So the end mark shows the true length
B) To make it longer
C) To use less ruler
D) No reason
items.answer: A) So the end mark shows the true length

steps: Starting at $0$ gives the true length.
